# telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachments (Data Source)

Lists agent gateway policy attachments, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachment`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The instance id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_policy_attachments` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_policy_attachments))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_policy_attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_policy_attachments`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the attachment was created.
- `default` (Boolean) `true` applies the policy only to the requests no other attachment matches.
- `id` (String) The attachment's ID.
- `models` (Set of String) The models whose requests the policy applies to, by name. A name can use `*` as a wildcard. Empty applies the policy to every request.
- `policy` (String) The policy to apply, by name.
- `priority` (Number) An attachment with a priority applies before the others.
- `updated_at` (String) When the attachment last changed.
